summary: The V5 Skill produced high-quality architecture documentation for the FastAPI codebase — 9 functionally-named modules, 89% source file coverage, correct four-section per-file format throughout, a Mermaid dependency graph with weighted edges, and INDEX assembled automatically from DETAIL fragments. The single failure is V6 (persistent/recoverable): 4 of 9 modules (docs_src, advanced_middleware, app_an_py310, main — covering 417 files and ~79% of documented content) were written to disk but never submitted via submit_analysis. As a result, state.json reports 9.7% coverage and only 5 tasks, meaning a session resumed via get_progress() would incorrectly believe the bulk of the work is undone. The fix is operational: the Skill instructions are unambiguous ('Do NOT batch submit_analysis calls'), but the agent skipped the step for the second batch of modules — likely a context-pressure issue where the agent rushed to finish. Recommended fix: embed submit_analysis as a numbered mandatory step inside the sub-agent prompt template, not just in the post-writing epilogue where it is easily skipped.
